remarks: Your search is over! Your new home awaits you in this spacious end-unit, with an open floor plan and endless sunlight. An entertainers dream! This 2 bedroom townhouse, each with it's own full private bathroom, vaulted ceilings and skylights. Endless closet space, jetted-tub in master bath and copious storage, in addition to the attic, make for the perfect home to settle in to.  Located just Minutes to I95, Merritt Parkway, Norwalk Hospital, copious restaurants and retail and walking distance to the train.  Recent upgrades include: 1st Floor: new refrigerator, entire floor painted; 2nd Floor: all new flooring, washer/dryer.   Note: While I am the seller, I am also a licensed Realtor.  Property is being sold 'As is'.
